title: Every object of the derived category has a representing subcomplex of bounded size inside any given representative
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)

difficulty_reason: The lemma produces, in the situation of the chapter, a cardinal kappa such that every complex of O-modules representing an object K of D(O) contains a subcomplex representing K whose size is at most max(kappa, |K|) (statement lines 11237-11245). The proof (proof lines 11247-11293) first kills all cohomology classes by one bounded subcomplex, then builds an increasing chain of bounded subcomplexes whose comparison kernels stabilize, and takes the union. H2: a cardinal-bounded inductive construction with two inputs, written out in full.
